title: The early universe is a quantum register that grows with time

statements.text: The early inflationary universe is a quantum gravity register whose qubits are pixels of area of quantum de Sitter horizons, a register that grows at each Planck time step.

sources.quote: We consider a quantum gravity register that is a particular quantum memory register which grows with time, and whose qubits are pixels of area of quantum de Sitter horizons
